function.name: Travel
function.description: Move the player to a different location. Use this when the user says 'go to', 'travel to', 'move to', or mentions wanting to visit a place. Extract the destination name from their speech.

destination.description: The name of the location to travel to (e.g., 'Storage Shed', 'Food Court', 'Entrance')

function.name: UseItem
function.description: Use an item from the player's inventory. Call this when the user says 'use', 'activate', or 'try' followed by an item name.

itemName.description: The name of the item to use (e.g., 'Pistol', 'Crowbar', 'Key')

function.name: CraftItems
function.description: Combine two items together to create a new item. Use when the user says 'craft', 'combine', 'merge', or 'put together'.

item1.description: The name of the first item to combine

item2.description: The name of the second item to combine

function.name: PickUpItem
function.description: Pick up an item from the current location. Use when the user says 'pick up', 'take', 'grab', or 'get'.

itemName.description: The name of the item to pick up

function.name: LookAround
function.description: Examine the current location. Use when the user says 'look around', 'examine', 'search', or asks about the surroundings.

function.name: CheckInventory
function.description: Check what items the player is carrying. Use when the user says 'inventory', 'check items', 'what do I have', or similar.
